RILEY MAYNARD
 
Software Developer  |  AI Experienced  |  Security-Minded Builder
 
(717) 501-1740  |  ril3ymaynard@gmail.com  |  LinkedIn  |  GitHub
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
 
Recent graduate with coding and data foundation in Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, KQL, and C/C++, and prompt engineering 
with Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Base44. Triaged 60+ incidents at a Fortune 500 healthcare 
internship, improving triage speed by 27%. Co-founded a hair accessory startup that went from 500+ customer interviews to 
revenue in under four months. Comfortable in cross-cultural teams with conversational Spanish and basic Japanese.  
EXPERIENCE
 
Co-Founder | Vayla (Self-employed)                                                                                                                    Nov 2025 – Present 
• 
Designed, built, and launched a website and business that draws thousands of visitors per month and generates over 
$1,000 per month in revenue and has received over $15,000 in funding 
Cyber Incident Response Intern | Highmark Health (Remote)                                                                        Jun 2025 – Aug 2025 
• 
Analyzed network traffic and logs with Microsoft Sentinel and Wireshark to identify indicators of compromise, then 
investigated, triaged, and escalated 60+ incidents, improving triage speed by 27% 
IT Operations Specialist | Penn State University (Part-time)                                                                          Sep 2022 – May 2026 
• 
Managed 30+ daily tickets in ServiceNow across Windows and macOS, resolving hardware, software, network, and 
endpoint issues while maintaining SLA compliance and documenting fixes for the knowledge base 
PROJECTS
 
Momentum | JavaScript, HTML & CSS: https://github.com/Zecktix/Momentum                                                                 Nov 2026 
• 
Momentum is a self-hosted web application for managing tasks, daily habits, and a calendar with user accounts. It is built 
entirely using Node.js built-in modules and vanilla JavaScript without any external dependencies.  
Pulseboard | JavaScript, HTML & CSS: https://github.com/Zecktix/Pulseboard                                                                 Nov 2026 
• 
Business analytics dashboard featuring a zero-dependency Node.js server and a secure, read-only Shopify integration. 
Translates e-commerce data into revenue trends, profit metrics, and automated business health insights.
 
Ransomware Case Study | Penn State University (Research)                                                                        Jan 2026 – May 2026 
• 
Reconstructed a simulated municipal ransomware attack across the full kill chain and quantified $2.4M–$4.2M in exposure 
across PA, FTC, and IRS breach requirements 
TECHNICAL SKILLS
 
Programming & Query Languages: Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, KQL, C/C++, PHP, HTML, CSS, R 
AI & Developer Tooling: Prompt Engineering, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Base44, AWS 
Security & Data Tools: Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Wireshark, Snort, Nmap, Metasploit, Palo Alto Networks, Cofense 
Frameworks & Languages: NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, CMMC  |  English (native), Spanish (conversational), Japanese (basic) 
EDUCATION & ACTIVITIES
 
Penn State University | B.S., Cybersecurity and Analytical Operations                                                                            May 2026 
Minors: Security Risk Analysis; Information Science & Technology 
Certificates: NSA (CAE-CD), SRA (SRA-UCT)  |  CompTIA Security+ (in progress) 
Competitive Cyber Security Organization | Operations                                                                                                   Aug 2022 
• 
Competed in cyber defense events including Hivestorm, finishing in the top 10% of 400 teams
